summary: Prefer positive statements over negative ones because they're clearer and easier to translate, e.g. 'Save the file before closing the editor.'
questions: Should I phrase instructions positively or negatively?

answer_card.title: Avoid negative constructions
answer_card.answer_md: State what to do rather than what not to do. Write "Save the file before closing the editor." instead of "Do not close the editor without saving."
